task.title: Record the provenance-aware deterministic failure cause and its measured labelled-set result on L5b and L1
task.objective: At 14c0ad84 deriveFailureCause reads L5a's requestRelations: the failed step's own request moves ahead of every other request event before it, never ahead of evidence the provenance does not describe, a request issued after the failure is never cited, and without a link or provenance the earliest-first rule is unchanged. Measured without a model on the unchanged labelled set: labelled 11 rows 9/11 unchanged, six request-provenance rows 2/6 to 5/6, all 17 rows 11/17 to 14/17, false attributions 6 to 3, no regression. The model-facing requests are byte-identical on all 19 asked rows, so the recorded AI 9/17 stands and the gap widens to -5. Append a note to awkit-djnl.8 and to awkit-djnl.1 giving the change, the measured result and the remaining blocker. Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: both stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming the change commit and its measured deterministic result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, after the two `bd update --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` (303 issues) and the already-edited state documents: 9 outstanding / 294 closed with 135 edges, unchanged, and both narratives restating 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. verify:verifier-classification reconciled 257 scripts. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.

history.released_reason: baseline-provenance result noted on awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1, nothing closed, no edge changed, export refreshed
